text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
—Fufun♪ The Engagement was a bit different 
from usual years, wasn't it? 
No matter, though. This year's muses are 
truly special♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—"The dress chose me"..., huh. 
It's a little embarrassing to hear, but 
quite an honor.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm... so very happy too. 
To think I could receive such a wonderful 
racing outfit...

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
What a beautiful "answer"... Thank you 
all, so very much. 
Now then—let the Beauty Dream Cup begin—!
Display event title logo.

The Beauty Dream Cup—a chance to claim a 
magnificent, one-of-a-kind racing outfit 
created by the world-renowned designer, 
Beauty Anshinzawa...

At the auditions, countless Umamusume have 
poured their hearts out year after year, 
offering passionate "proposals" to those 
wedding dress-inspired racing outfits.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, the Beauty Dream Cup! 
Is it that time of year already? No wonder 
everyone's been so restless lately.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I mean, who wouldn't yearn for 
that? 
Not that I'd ever have the guts to enter 
myself, though...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally...! I'd love to give it a 
shot someday, but... 
I'm still nowhere near ready...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come on now, don't go selling yourself 
short before you've even tried. 
You won't know what you're lacking until 
you actually give it a go, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If you're hesitating to take that first 
step, then I'll just have to go first! 
Big Sis Hishi Ama will show you all how 
it's done and become the Muse!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Waaah...! Big Sis Hishi Amaaa—!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The Muse, huh... That sounds wonderful. I 
wonder if I could do it if I tried my 
best? 
I bet Mom and Dad would be so happy to see 
me in a new racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure lots of older girls will apply, 
but... 
nothing starts unless you take a chance... 
Right...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. I sense formidable rivals. 
However, I will not surrender Ms. Beauty's 
racing outfit to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ms. Chan. 
Are you participating as well?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, it won't be just Chan. 
Chan's classmates will also be entering 
with fiery passion.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wow, really? 
By classmates, you mean, um... Ah!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yo, is this spot open—? 
...Wait. Scarlet... you too?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What of it? It's crowded today, so what 
else was I supposed to do? 
Besides, I was about to ask first 
anyway...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Talk of the devil, and their shadows 
appear. Out of the blue, but to the both 
of you: 
Are you interested in the Beauty Dream 
Cup?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Won't you enter together with Chan? You 
will, right? 
If the three classmates enter together, we 
are guaranteed to draw immense attention.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, so you're inviting them right now...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, honestly, I've been eyeing that! Even 
if they're based on wedding dresses, 
Beauty Anshinzawa makes some seriously 
cool ones too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Pantsuits, biker jackets and stuff... 
She makes all kinds of styles tailored to 
each Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A new racing outfit sounds like the 
perfect hype-up. 
I'll rock it, win my next race for sure... 
and pull off one hell of a comeback!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I've been wanting to enter too. 
As an honor student, I have to aim high, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I believe aiming to be the Muse will help 
elevate myself. 
I want to aim for number one in both 
strength and beauty!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. So both of you are very 
eager to enter. 
Just as Chan predicted. Fans of our whole 
class will surely be delighted.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But... applications haven't even opened 
yet this year, have they? Around this time 
last year, details were already—wait! Look 
at this, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
—Ms. Beauty remains "missing," and her 
agency has announced that this year's 
Beauty Dream Cup's status is "to be 
determined."

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
A handwritten note saying "Please do not 
look for me" was left behind in her 
atelier, suggesting foul play is unlikely, 
however—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: M-Missing...!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Whaaaat did you say!? Beauty Anshinzawa 
is...!? 
Whoa, whoa, what the heck is that about!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I see... So you were planning on taking 
part in the Beauty Dream Cup as well, 
Hishi Ama-san.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, talk about bad timing. And just when 
I was getting ready to step up for those 
girls, too...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Ms. Beauty is safe? 
Will she be okay...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Flower... she'll be fine. She's an adult, 
so there's no need to worry! 
She's probably just relaxing and taking a 
breather somewhere, right?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Judging from her note... hm?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What is it...? Did those bushes over there 
just move?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Is there a cat in there? Come to think 
of it, back in elementary school, I caught 
a dog that snuck onto the school grounds 
once~...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Gotchaaa... wait! WHOAAA!!?

Awawawa! I've been spotted!? 
Nooo way! Adieuuuu☆!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Vodka! Are you alright? 
WOOOAAAH!! Hold it right there, you—!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama-san, wait! 
It's dangerous to go alone—!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heyyy! You suspicious weirdo~~!! Where the 
hell did you go—!? 
Stop hiding and get out hereee!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Did you really think you could get away 
from me? 
I'm definitely gonna catch youuu—!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
『Emergency, emergency! This is E-Mer-chan 
broadcasting from the AV room. 
The prime suspect is fleeing south, 
currently being pursued by Hishi Ama-san. 
Send backup immediately—』

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Aha, cornered! Give it up!

N-Nooo—!! It's a misunderstanding! 
I was just looking for inspirationnn...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! Aren't you... !?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Beauty Anshinzawa!? 
It's freaking Beauty Anshinzawa!?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... "Beauty"... 
That name feels like a complete joke to me 
right now...

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
What even is "beauty"? What is true 
"Beauty"...? 
Aaaah! It's no use! I can't think of 
anythiiing!!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally done for! I'm in a huge 
sluuump! 
Please, hide meeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa, whoa, whoa! 
What's with the sudden waterworks? What 
happened to you?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Geez, just calm down for a second! In 
times like this, take a deep breath. 
Here, I'll rub your back, so just...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see. Mm-hmm, got it. I have assessed the 
situation. 
This is a super-sized emergency.
